signals.title: Distributed general-purpose agent networks
signals.summary: Agent networks are framed around local data, tool permissions, runtime environments, and governance boundaries.
signals.implication: Reassess role boundaries, human override, and cross-instance governance before community deployment.

signals.title: LLM-as-judge in education
signals.summary: Automated marking needs curriculum-grounded pipelines and authorized assessment artifacts.
signals.implication: Useful precedent for C2A2 education workflows that must cite local curricula and review standards.

signals.title: Verbal reinforcement learning and insight governance
signals.summary: Agents update behavior through verbal rules extracted from experience, raising retention and forgetting questions.
signals.implication: Heartbeat memory should record when old rules are stale, superseded, or reactivated.

signals.title: Dissecting model behavior through agent trajectories
signals.summary: Agent performance is treated as a systems problem rather than only a model benchmark.
signals.implication: Community education should teach harnesses, permissions, logs, and review loops, not just model names.

signals.title: AI prototypes from a university futures lab
signals.summary: Student AI prototypes point toward education and work reshaping through practical demos.
signals.implication: Good candidate for a community-facing discussion of useful experimentation versus adoption pressure.
